task.title: Sign in is broken
task.description:
Trying to sign in with an email address and password on the web app just gives this error message: "Invalid origin". It works on the desktop app.

For Google Log in:
In the desktop app, the browser opens the google auth page, but then redirects to a web app page with the error message: "Google sign-in didn't complete — try again." and the desktop app is left with the sign in google button showing "Waiting for Google".

On the web, clicking "Continue with Google" just shows the message "Google sign-in isn't available right now — use email and password."
